integrity: Proof by rational finite-state carry matrices, a convergent geometric suffix, a characteristic identity and exact polynomial-part extraction; a standalone exact symbolic checker and finite corroboration are included.
scientific_limitations: Exact nonnegative change law only for the binary adjacent-11 statistic under shifts 2^a+1, a>=1. Negative-change distributions remain parameter-dependent. No claim for arbitrary shifts or other binary patterns. Bibliographic priority is not independently established.
title: Exact stabilization of nonnegative binary 11-block changes under two-bit shifts
